behavior.continuity_loss_policy: retain every missing sequence and error through forced reconnect; phase-specific fresh probes require full delivery; continuity flow alone never establishes success
behavior.positive_gates: real tun/ovpn path and source-route; exact payload+echo before/after rekey/reconnect; no old duplicate/corrupt deliveries; actual TLS/key events and HIA entry trace when used

plan.cleanup: only recorded case PIDs/groups and recorded namespace name+inode; remove private-work PKI; preserve public raw failures
plan.host_scope: one disposable GitHub-hosted Ubuntu24.04 x86_64 VM; two isolated local network namespaces per case; no WAN generalization

performance.claim_limit: finite paired virtual-network observations on one shared hosted VM; not production, WAN, hardware-NIC or cross-host performance qualification
performance.cpu_affinity: server: first allowed CPU, client: second allowed CPU; workload endpoints share their role CPU; exact host affinity recorded
performance.outlier_policy: retain all trials, startup, losses, resets, failures and raw iperf fields; no selection or confidence inflation

profile.fallback: record failure; do not relabel gprof as complete process/kernel profile

blockers: requires provisioned target CAP_NET_ADMIN and CAP_SYS_ADMIN; no escalation is attempted
